overview_description.description: The Stories Studio is a Bahrain based indie game development studio. They believe that video games are the ultimate art form and want to use this art medium to make a difference. They do this by creating fun and engaging games around important real-world causes, and by contributing back 2.5% portion of their sales back to the cause.
